etymology.historical_story: Franklin began as an English social designation for a free landholder rather than a nobleman. The designation became a surname and later also a given name. Its earlier forms include Middle English frankeleyn and Anglo-Norman fraunclein. This explains the name's historical background, but does not identify which Franklin the supplied lowercase token denotes. [Surname dictionary](https://www.ancestry.co.uk/last-name-meaning/franklin)
